If pain becomes unmanageable, it is usually a sign to stop, rest, and possibly adjust your medication before attempting movement again. Remember that a slower, pain-free start often leads to a faster, more complete recovery than a rushed attempt that causes setbacks. Always prioritize professional medical advice over general internet suggestions when navigating post-operative care.
